one_month_reasoning: The window to 2026-11-08 contains Q3 2026 results (not yet officially dated; Corning reported Q3 2025 on Oct 28 and Q2 2026 on Jul 28, so expect ~Oct 27-28). Q3 guidance is core sales $4.9-5.0B and core EPS $0.85-0.89 (Q2 release); Corning has beaten its own EPS guide in recent quarters (Q1 $0.70 vs $0.66-0.70 guide; Q2 $0.78 vs $0.73-0.77), so an EPS print at/above the top end is likely. What moves the stock is the first Q4 guide (CFO said Q3 implies reaching the $20B run rate 'a quarter or so early') and optical growth vs. the 'capacity limited' narrative; the July print showed a beat can still trade -16% on the outlook. The $2B ATM (Sep 11 8-K) is a modest overhang (~1.5% of shares). With realized vol ~60% (1y) / ~76% (3m), I use a near-symmetric log spread with sigma ~18% for the month (annual/3.5 plus an earnings bump) centered just below spot (~$156) - no directional call.

fair_value.method: Blend of 30x NTM core EPS at Oct-2027 (~$5.03) = $151 (65%) and a 2027-2033 FCF DCF at 9.5% WACC / 4% terminal growth = $119 (35%), giving ~$140.

methods.inputs: NTM core EPS at Oct-2027 ~$5.03 (0.25 x 2027 $4.37 + 0.75 x 2028 ~$5.25) x 30x (peer median NTM P/E 29.7x)

inputs_detail.derivation: $4.37 x 1.22 = $5.33 (management: 19% sales CAGR Q4'26-Q4'30 with earnings growing faster than sales, Q2 release/call), less ~1.5% dilution from the $2B ATM at ~$155 (~13M shares on ~875M core diluted) and NVIDIA traditional warrant (15M @ $180, treasury method) = ~$5.25

Peer median forward P/E 29.7x (11 peers, range 11.8x-50.7x). GLW's consensus 2027 EPS growth (+33%: $3.29->$4.37) is close to the peer median next-year growth (~36%); about half of GLW revenue (Glass Innovations, Automotive, Solar, Life Sciences) is slower/cyclical, and core ROIC is 14.9% (Q2 release), so no persistent premium is justified; 30x ~ peer median.

methods.name: DCF
methods.inputs: 2027 FCF $2.9B (75% of consensus core net income $3.87B), growth 28/24/20/15/10/7% for 2028-2033, WACC 9.5%, terminal g 4%, net debt $5.9B, 890M shares; valued at ~end-2027

inputs_detail.derivation: $4.37 consensus EPS x ~885M diluted shares (875M Q2 core diluted + ATM)

H1 2026 adjusted FCF $1,611M vs core net income ~$1,293M (0.70x871M + 0.78x875M) = 125%, but the 10-Q shows Q2 included a $1.0B customer deposit; ex-deposit ~47%. Capex guided ~$2B for 2026 and rising in H2 (call) to fund NVIDIA 10x connectivity build. Long-term agreements carry prepayments, so 75% sits between the two.
Management 19% sales CAGR Q4'26-Q4'30 with earnings faster than sales; FCF faster still early as capex intensity falls from build-out peak, then fades.
Beta 1.12 (5y) x ~5% ERP + ~4.2% risk-free ~ 9.8% cost of equity; modest debt (net debt ~$6-7B vs $135B market cap) -> ~9.5%
Total debt $8,424M - cash $2,504M at Jun 30 2026 = $5,920M (S&P data shows $6.88B incl. leases, src 12)
Springboard targets imply growth continuing past 2030 ($40B run rate); 4% after a 7-year fade

bear.story: Hyperscaler capex digestion in 2027 plus share loss/price pressure as fiber capacity floods in; optical growth slows to low teens, Glass/Auto flat, Solar losses persist. NTM EPS ~$4.4 and multiple de-rates toward ~21-22x (TEL/peer lower half), plus ATM dilution.

base.story: Springboard on track: ~$20B run rate exited 2026, 2027 EPS ~$4.4, 2028 ~$5.2-5.3; multiple compresses from ~36x 2027 EPS today to ~30x NTM (peer median) as growth normalises -> ~$150.

bull.story: Optical capacity additions (NVIDIA, Amazon, Meta, Verizon deals) ramp ahead of plan, CPO/scale-up optics adds content, Solar reaches profitability; 2028 EPS ~$5.8 and market holds ~37x NTM -> ~$215 (still below the June-2026 high of $255).

comps_summary.our_multiple_vs_peers: GLW trades at 42.3x NTM (S&P via StockAnalysis), ~36x 2027 consensus, trailing EV/EBITDA 34.7x - above the peer median P/E. We apply 30x NTM at the horizon, at the peer median.
comps_summary.premium_discount_justification: No premium: GLW's consensus 2027 EPS growth (+33%) is in line with the peer median (~36%), roughly half its revenue is in slower/cyclical segments (Glass Innovations +1% y/y in Q2, Automotive, Solar loss-making), ROIC 14.9% is below asset-light peers, and growth requires heavy capex plus equity (ATM, warrants). Mitigants against a discount: contracted multi-year agreements with customer deposits ($2.7B contract liabilities) give visibility. Net: use median.

thesis_break_reason: Below the July-2026 post-earnings panic low ($114.50 intraday) and ~25x 2027 consensus; trading there would most likely mean the optical demand/contract story has broken (a hyperscaler cutting or deferring LTAs, deposits not renewed, or Q4/2027 guide implying growth well below the 19% CAGR), not just multiple volatility.

reasoning: Primary documents: Q2 2026 release shows core sales +17% to $4.74B, core EPS +30% to $0.78, core op margin 20.9%, Optical +32%; Q3 guide $0.85-0.89. The 10-Q adds what recaps skip: H1 adjusted FCF ($1.61B) includes a $1.0B customer deposit (supply deal to 2029) net of a $296M warrant reduction, no buybacks in H1, $3.0B authorisation unused; and the Sep 11 8-K launched a $2B ATM - Corning is now funding capacity with customer cash and equity, not returning capital. May 6 8-K: NVIDIA got 15M warrants @ $180 + 3M pre-funded for $500M. Consensus (S&P) 2026/2027 EPS $3.29/$4.37. Valuation: 30x NTM EPS (peer median of 11 AI-infrastructure/connectivity peers) on ~$5.03 = $151, DCF $119 (9.5% WACC; $108-$132 at 10%-9%), blended $140, ~11% below spot; analyst mean target $188 is noted but not used. Distribution: lognormal centered at a ~$148 median (between fair value and spot, since momentum and LTA visibility argue against full convergence within 12 months), sigma 0.50 (below 1y realized ~60% which included a once-off re-rating, well above a typical large-cap). That gives P(>=157) ~0.45 and P(>=110) ~0.72; tails 1-2% at the extremes. Scenario mean ~$152. Limits: corning.com and some transcript sites returned 403; Investor Day deck not read, so no 2030 EPS/margin target is used; Twelve Data/Alpha Vantage estimates endpoints unavailable. Lane share: comps requirement (11 peers x 2 data pages) means only ~30% of listed sources are primary documents, though every GLW-specific fact used is from filings/the call except consensus EPS and peer data.
